title: Alibaba Cloud WAIC forum: TPN (Token Performance Network), KVCacheStore, and TokenWorks disclosed by Wu Jiesheng
event_hint: Alibaba Cloud's 2026 WAIC Agentic Cloud forum where VP Wu Jiesheng publicly detailed TPN — a single inference-network fabric consolidating PD-separated, AF-separated, KV Cache Store, and cloud-service traffic
problem: Multi-turn agentic and long-context inference is causing KV-cache data to grow explosively, exceeding GPU HBM + memory + local-disk capacity, which lowers cache hit rate and inference throughput. Separately, distinct inference traffic types (PD separation, AF separation, KV-cache access, cloud-service access) each requiring their own network complicates the system and raises cost.
mechanism: TPN (Token Performance Network) is a network architecture purpose-built for inference that consolidates multiple traffic types — PD (prefill-decode) separation traffic, AF (agent-function) separation traffic, KV Cache Store access traffic, and cloud-service access traffic — onto a single network fabric. Within this fabric, bandwidth is allocated on-demand across traffic types with performance isolation and QoS guarantees, simplifying network complexity and lowering inference cost. KVCacheStore (G3.5-tier) is co-located with compute under the TPN fabric for high-performance access, uses a compute-storage disaggregated architecture (independent elastic scaling, supports hundreds of billions of KV elements), and exposes a KV interface for open-source and proprietary inference engines.

evidence.claim: TPN consolidates PD-separation, AF-separation, KV-Cache-Store-access, and cloud-service traffic on one network with on-demand bandwidth allocation, performance isolation, and QoS guarantees.
evidence.source_locator: Wu Jiesheng speech, section '阿里云推KV缓存': "我们有 PD 分离的网络流量...我们可以按需的分配带宽，提供不同流量之间的一个性能的隔离，以及它的服务质量的保障"
evidence.condition: As described by Alibaba Cloud VP Wu Jiesheng at WAIC 2026

evidence.claim: KVCacheStore improved cache hit rate by up to 20% in customer POC validation.
evidence.source_locator: Section '阿里云推KV缓存': "KV Cache Store 可以提高缓存命中率高达20%"
evidence.baseline: prior cache hit rate without KVCacheStore

evidence.claim: TokenWorks reduces model time-to-online from days to tens of minutes.
evidence.source_locator: Section '阿里云推KV缓存': "模型上线从几天下降到几十分钟"

evidence.claim: Container-based inference reduced cold-start latency by up to 90%, raised GPU utilization by 35%, and cut per-token average output time by 60% for some customers.
evidence.source_locator: Section '阿里云推KV缓存': "降低冷启动的时延高达90%...GPU使用率提升35%，每个Token平均输出耗时降低60%"
evidence.value: cold-start -90%, GPU util +35%, per-token output time -60%
evidence.condition: some customers using container-based inference solution

evidence.claim: DeepSeek's inference software optimization cut token cost 60% over six months and achieved ~3x throughput on identical hardware.
evidence.source_locator: Mark Collier quote, section '模型不再是唯一核心': "六个月内，token成本降低了60%...在完全相同的硬件上实现了近三倍的吞吐量"
evidence.condition: DeepSeek published case study, cited by Mark Collier

evaluation_context: Forum disclosures from a vendor event (WAIC 2026, Shanghai). Performance figures are customer POC results or vendor-reported, not independently benchmarked. No specific hardware model numbers, cluster sizes, or P95/P99 latency distributions were given for TPN itself. Scale context: Alibaba Cloud claims 40.1% market share in full-stack AI cloud services and states 'at least half of China's LLM companies run on Alibaba Cloud.'
limitations: This is a secondary source: Chinese financial-media (wallstreetcn.com) transcript/summary of a vendor forum, not Alibaba's primary technical documentation. Quotes are from a live transcript and may contain transcription artifacts. [explicit] No end-to-end TTFT, TPOT, token throughput, network utilization, or P95 numbers were provided specifically for the TPN fabric itself — only aggregate product-level metrics (cache hit rate, cold-start, GPU util). [explicit] TPN's internal mechanisms (congestion control, scheduling algorithm, protocol details) are not described at engineering depth in this coverage. [explicit] discovery_only is true for this source, indicating it was flagged for awareness rather than as a primary technical reference. [explicit]
project_relevance: Directly relevant to the TPN/inference-network briefing interest. TPN is the named system the briefing tracks: a single inference-aware network fabric that carries PD-separated, AF-separated, and KV-cache-store traffic with on-demand bandwidth and QoS. The KVCacheStore co-location under TPN directly addresses KVCache cross-node transfer and access. The disclosed metrics (cache hit rate, cold-start, per-token time) touch the briefing's valuable-evidence list, though they lack the TTFT/TPOT/P95 granularity desired. This forum coverage is best used as a lead to locate Alibaba's primary AI-Network whitepaper for engineering detail.
source_notes: Secondary financial-media coverage of Alibaba Cloud's WAIC 2026 'Agentic Cloud' forum.

The same forum also covered: super-node instance (64 cards, 800GB interconnect, 9TB HBM), Seal software stack open-sourcing, Agentic FS, and sandbox scaling (100k/min cold start, 1M per region). These are adjacent to but outside the TPN core scope.
Li Feifei (Alibaba Cloud CTO) and Mark Collier (PyTorch Foundation) discussion frames the inference-efficiency economic argument (per-result pricing, token cost reduction).
